cohort: The cohort consisted of 235 women with singleton pregnancies confirmed to have trisomy 21.
finding: Fetuses with Trisomy 21 exhibited anthropometric differences compared to the general population, with smaller head circumference, femur length, and biparietal diameter, and a larger abdominal circumference from 29 weeks onward, although overall estimated fetal weight was not different from the reference standard.
gest_age: All gestational ages, with specific mentions of the second and late third trimesters, and from 29 weeks onward.
